newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may cut Fisher Scientific.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may cut Fisher Scientific.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it placed the senior unsecured debt ratings of Fisher Scientific International Inc on rating watch-down.
The move affects about $150 million in debt of the scientific products company, Duff & Phelps said.

"The rating action follows announcment of efforts by Trinity I Fund L.P to encourage a leveraged recapitalizaiton of Fisher, which will likely increase debt levels and weaken credit protection measures," Duff & Phelps said in a research note.
Trinity made the proposal in a June 4 letter to Fisher chioef executive Paul Montrone, which was included in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
